description: This file contains CUDA code generation utilities for NVIDIA's Cutlass library, including classes and functions for handling epilogue functors, tensor creation, argument rendering, and source code tracing for CUDA kernels within the PyTorch _inductor compiler backend.

classes.name: EVTArgRenames
classes.description: Handles mapping buffer names to variable names in the CUDA kernel signature and body

classes.name: EpilogueFunctor
classes.description: Represents a CUDA epilogue functor, used for code generation and source code tracing

methods.name: new_name
methods.description: Generates a new variable name for a buffer, ensuring uniqueness

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the renamed variable for a given buffer name

methods.name: create_example_tensors
methods.description: Creates example tensor objects from buffers for CUDA kernel code generation

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Performs source code tracing and generates CUDA kernel code for a given function source

methods.name: _trace
methods.description: Internal function that creates an EpilogueFunctor object from source code string

methods.name: _render_argument_type
methods.description: Renders the argument types for the CUDA kernel, including thread and buffer info

methods.name: _get_arg_from_node
methods.description: Generates argument string representations from buffer nodes based on type
